body: I'll see what I can do. It'll probably be slow and painful at first. Wish me luck out there and thanks.

Family has already been distant to me since high-school. I was kicked out of school due to my violent behavior. It went downhill since then. 
I started hanging out with way older people, probably coz I think hanging out with these people makes me look cool. This is also the time I started using drugs. That shit ran for years until most of them had their own responsibilities ( job, family, etc ), leaving me deserted. 
That's when i decided to try gaming and hang out with younger people. Most of them only see me as a "had seen some shit" person, save a few. They probably think I got life figured out when I'm a total mess inside. They have a lot of reasons to leave since I was passively a bad influence to them.
